WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4
-- Logic: Projects retail calendar week data from ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK,
--        filtered to clients 120 and 200. Provides week/year/period
--        attributes used to enrich flash sales data.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120', '200')
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_md_rcalweek_s4 AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    zzweek,
    zcalyrp,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    zryrqtr,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: cv_base_navix
-- Logic: Projects base NAVIX POS transaction keys (store, date, currency).
--        Used as the base grain for flash sales assembly.
-- Source: POSDW/NAVIX (BQ mapping UNRESOLVED - see ISSUES TO FIX #7)
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_navix AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CURRENCY
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_NAVIX`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_NAVIX with actual BQ table
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: cv_base_tlogf_filtered
-- Logic: Projects and filters POS transaction log (TLOGF) to
--        RECORDQUALIFIER IN ('5','6'), excluding specific transaction
--        types, workstation 0000000000, archived rows, and zero timestamps.
--        Used as the source for FS sales, discounts, RX sales, and
--        employee discount branches.
-- Source: POSDW/TLOGF (BQ mapping UNRESOLVED - see ISSUES TO FIX #8)
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER IN ('5','6'), TRANSTYPECODE NOT IN
--          ('1107','1197','1020'), WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000',
--          ARCHIVED = '', ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0'
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_tlogf_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    RECORDQUALIFIER,
    TRANSTYPECODE,
    WORKSTATIONID,
    SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    ARCHIVED,
    RETAILTYPECODE,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    DISCTYPECODE,
    TRANSCURRENCY
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF with actual BQ table
  WHERE RECORDQUALIFIER IN ('5', '6')
    AND TRANSTYPECODE NOT IN ('1107', '1197', '1020')
    AND WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000'
    AND ARCHIVED = ''
    AND ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: cv_base_tlogf_x_filtered
-- Logic: Projects and filters POS extended transaction log (TLOGF_X)
--        to RECORDQUALIFIER = '25', excluding workstation 0000000000
--        and zero timestamps. Provides RX script counts and customer
--        type for script KPI calculations.
-- Source: POSDW/TLOGF_X (BQ mapping UNRESOLVED - see ISSUES TO FIX #9)
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER = '25', WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000',
--          ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0'
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_tlogf_x_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    RECORDQUALIFIER,
    WORKSTATIONID,
    ARCHIVED,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_CUSTTYPE,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF_X`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF_X with actual BQ table
  WHERE RECORDQUALIFIER = '25'
    AND WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000'
    AND ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: cv_base_tlogf_covid_filtered
-- Logic: Projects and filters TLOGF for COVID sales (ITEMID = 'A01-433556'),
--        applying the same standard TLOGF filters. Provides CVD_AMOUNT.
-- Source: POSDW/TLOGF (BQ mapping UNRESOLVED - see ISSUES TO FIX #8)
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER IN ('5','6'), TRANSTYPECODE NOT IN
--          ('1107','1197','1020'), WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000',
--          ARCHIVED = '', ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0', ITEMID = 'A01-433556'
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_tlogf_covid_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    RECORDQUALIFIER,
    TRANSTYPECODE,
    WORKSTATIONID,
    SALESAMOUNT,
    ARCHIVED,
    RETAILTYPECODE,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    DISCTYPECODE,
    TRANSCURRENCY
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.POSDW_TLOGF with actual BQ table
  WHERE RECORDQUALIFIER IN ('5', '6')
    AND TRANSTYPECODE NOT IN ('1107', '1197', '1020')
    AND WORKSTATIONID <> '0000000000'
    AND ARCHIVED = ''
    AND ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <> '0'
    AND ITEMID = 'A01-433556'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: cv_base_parameters
-- Logic: Projects flash parameter table (ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM) exposing
--        PARAM_NAME, LOW_CHAR (PARAM_VALUE_LOW), HIGH_CHAR (PARAM_VALUE_HIGH).
--        Used to filter retail type codes and discount type codes.
-- Source: ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM (BQ mapping UNRESOLVED - see ISSUES TO FIX #10)
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_parameters AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    PARAM_NAME,
    PARAM_VALUE_LOW AS LOW_CHAR,
    PARAM_VALUE_HIGH AS HIGH_CHAR
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM with actual BQ table
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: fs_sales_branch
-- Logic: Filters TLOGF to FS sales records (RECORDQUALIFIER = '5'),
--        inner-joined to FS retail type codes from parameters table.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_filtered, cv_base_parameters
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER = '5', PARAM_NAME = 'FS_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
-- Join: INNER JOIN on RETAILTYPECODE = LOW_CHAR
-- =====================================================================
fs_sales_branch AS (
  SELECT
    t.MANDT,
    t.RETAILSTOREID,
    t.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    t.SALESAMOUNT AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    t.RETAILTYPECODE,
    t.TRANSCURRENCY,
    t.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_filtered t
  INNER JOIN cv_base_parameters p
    ON t.RETAILTYPECODE = p.LOW_CHAR
  WHERE t.RECORDQUALIFIER = '5'
    AND p.PARAM_NAME = 'FS_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: fs_discount_branch
-- Logic: Filters TLOGF to FS discount records (RECORDQUALIFIER = '6'),
--        inner-joined to FS discount type codes from parameters table.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_filtered, cv_base_parameters
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER = '6', PARAM_NAME = 'FS_DISC_TYPE_CODE'
-- Join: INNER JOIN on DISCTYPECODE = LOW_CHAR
-- =====================================================================
fs_discount_branch AS (
  SELECT
    t.MANDT,
    t.RETAILSTOREID,
    t.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    t.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    t.RETAILTYPECODE,
    t.DISCTYPECODE,
    t.TRANSCURRENCY,
    t.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS FS_DISC_UPD_TIMESTAMP
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_filtered t
  INNER JOIN cv_base_parameters p
    ON t.DISCTYPECODE = p.LOW_CHAR
  WHERE t.RECORDQUALIFIER = '6'
    AND p.PARAM_NAME = 'FS_DISC_TYPE_CODE'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: rx_sales_branch
-- Logic: Filters TLOGF to RX sales records (RECORDQUALIFIER = '5'),
--        inner-joined to RX retail type codes from parameters table.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_filtered, cv_base_parameters
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER = '5', PARAM_NAME = 'RX_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
-- Join: INNER JOIN on RETAILTYPECODE = LOW_CHAR
-- =====================================================================
rx_sales_branch AS (
  SELECT
    t.MANDT,
    t.RETAILSTOREID,
    t.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    t.SALESAMOUNT AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    t.RETAILTYPECODE,
    t.TRANSCURRENCY,
    t.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_filtered t
  INNER JOIN cv_base_parameters p
    ON t.RETAILTYPECODE = p.LOW_CHAR
  WHERE t.RECORDQUALIFIER = '5'
    AND p.PARAM_NAME = 'RX_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: emp_discount_branch
-- Logic: Filters TLOGF to employee discount records (RECORDQUALIFIER = '6'),
--        inner-joined to employee discount type codes from parameters table.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_filtered, cv_base_parameters
-- Filters: RECORDQUALIFIER = '6', PARAM_NAME = 'EMP_DISC_TYPE_CODE'
-- Join: INNER JOIN on DISCTYPECODE = LOW_CHAR
-- =====================================================================
emp_discount_branch AS (
  SELECT
    t.MANDT,
    t.RETAILSTOREID,
    t.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    t.REDUCTIONAMOUNT AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    t.RETAILTYPECODE,
    t.DISCTYPECODE,
    t.TRANSCURRENCY,
    t.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS EMP_DISC_UPD_TIMESTAMP
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_filtered t
  INNER JOIN cv_base_parameters p
    ON t.DISCTYPECODE = p.LOW_CHAR
  WHERE t.RECORDQUALIFIER = '6'
    AND p.PARAM_NAME = 'EMP_DISC_TYPE_CODE'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: covid_sales_branch
-- Logic: Filters TLOGF_COVID to COVID sales, inner-joined to RX retail
--        type codes. Provides CVD_AMOUNT.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_covid_filtered, cv_base_parameters
-- Filters: PARAM_NAME = 'RX_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
-- Join: INNER JOIN on RETAILTYPECODE = LOW_CHAR
-- =====================================================================
covid_sales_branch AS (
  SELECT
    c.MANDT,
    c.RETAILSTOREID,
    c.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    c.SALESAMOUNT AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    c.RETAILTYPECODE,
    c.TRANSCURRENCY,
    c.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS CVD_UPD_TIMESTAMP
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_covid_filtered c
  INNER JOIN cv_base_parameters p
    ON c.RETAILTYPECODE = p.LOW_CHAR
  WHERE p.PARAM_NAME = 'RX_RETAIL_TYPE_CODE'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: script_kpis
-- Logic: Joins TLOGF_X scripts data to NAVIX (second instance) to get
--        CURRENCY. Computes CAL_FS_UNITS, CAL_RX_CNT_* from text fields,
--        and CAL_CVD_UNITS from workstation/customer-type logic.
-- Source: cv_base_tlogf_x_filtered, cv_base_navix
-- Join: INNER JOIN on MANDT, RETAILSTOREID, BUSINESSDAYDATE
-- Calculation: CAL_FS_UNITS, CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS, CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
--              CAL_RX_CNT_NS, CAL_RX_CNT_RE, CAL_CVD_UNITS
-- =====================================================================
script_kpis AS (
  SELECT
    s.MANDT,
    s.RETAILSTOREID,
    s.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    s.ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    s.ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    s.ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    s.ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    s.ZZ_CUSTTYPE,
    n.CURRENCY,
    s.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    s.WORKSTATIONID,
    CASE
      WHEN s.ZZ_CUSTTYPE IN ('F', 'M', 'R') THEN 1
      WHEN s.ZZ_CUSTTYPE IN ('X', 'Y', 'Z') THEN -1
      ELSE 0
    END AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CASE WHEN s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS = '' THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS AS INT64) END AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CASE WHEN s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE = '' THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(s.ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE AS INT64) END AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CASE WHEN s.ZZ_RX_CNT_NS = '' THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(s.ZZ_RX_CNT_NS AS INT64) END AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CASE WHEN s.ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL = '' THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(s.ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL AS INT64) END AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    CASE
      WHEN s.WORKSTATIONID = '0000000555' AND s.ZZ_CUSTTYPE = 'C' THEN 1
      WHEN s.WORKSTATIONID = '0000000555' AND s.ZZ_CUSTTYPE = 'W' THEN -1
      ELSE 0
    END AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM cv_base_tlogf_x_filtered s
  INNER JOIN cv_base_navix n
    ON s.MANDT = n.MANDT
   AND s.RETAILSTOREID = n.RETAILSTOREID
   AND s.BUSINESSDAYDATE = n.BUSINESSDAYDATE
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: combined_flash_sales_inputs
-- Logic: Unions six branches (scripts, FS sales, employee discount,
--        RX sales, FS discount, COVID sales) with NULL-padded non-
--        applicable columns per branch. Intermediate step before
--        COMBINE_DATA aggregation.
-- Source: script_kpis, fs_sales_branch, emp_discount_branch,
--         rx_sales_branch, fs_discount_branch, covid_sales_branch
-- =====================================================================
combined_flash_sales_inputs AS (
  -- Branch 1: Script KPIs
  SELECT
    ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    CURRENCY AS TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM script_kpis

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 2: FS Sales
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM fs_sales_branch

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 3: Employee Discount
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    EMP_DISC_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM emp_discount_branch

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 4: RX Sales
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM rx_sales_branch

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 5: FS Discount
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_DISC_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM fs_discount_branch

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 6: COVID Sales
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CVD_UPD_TIMESTAMP AS ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM covid_sales_branch
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: COMBINE_DATA
-- Logic: Aggregates the unioned flash sales inputs by
--        MANDT, RETAILSTOREID, BUSINESSDAYDATE, TRANSCURRENCY,
--        ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP. Produces pre-merged sales totals.
-- Source: combined_flash_sales_inputs
-- Aggregation: SUM for sales/count/unit measures; MAX for timestamps;
--              COUNT for raw ZZ_RX_* string fields
-- =====================================================================
COMBINE_DATA AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(FS_SALESAMOUNT)        AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(REDUCTIONAMOUNT)       AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(RX_SALESAMOUNT)        AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_CNT_NS)        AS ZZ_RX_CNT_NS,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL)    AS ZZ_RX_CNT_REFILL,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)   AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_NS_RAW,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)   AS ZZ_RX_CNT_GE84_RE_RAW,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS)  AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_NS,
    COUNT(ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE)  AS ZZ_RX_MCRX_GE84_RE,
    SUM(CAL_FS_UNITS)          AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)   AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)    AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)    AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_NS)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_RE)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(CVD_AMOUNT)            AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_CVD_UNITS)         AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM combined_flash_sales_inputs
  GROUP BY
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: cv_base_fin_flash_sales_car_filtered
-- Logic: Applies timestamp filter from IP_UPD_TIMESTAMP_FROM/TO
--        parameters to NAVIX-merged flash sales. This is the
--        CV_BASE_FIN_FLASH_SALES_CAR layer.
-- Source: cv_base_navix (NAVIX), COMBINE_DATA
-- Filters: ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP >= @ip_upd_timestamp_from AND <= @ip_upd_timestamp_to
-- Join: INNER JOIN NAVIX to COMBINE_DATA on MANDT, RETAILSTOREID, BUSINESSDAYDATE
-- Aggregation: SUM for numeric measures, MAX for timestamps
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_fin_flash_sales_car_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    n.MANDT,
    n.RETAILSTOREID,
    n.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    c.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    c.TRANSCURRENCY,
    SUM(c.FS_SALESAMOUNT)        AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(c.REDUCTIONAMOUNT)       AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(c.RX_SALESAMOUNT)        AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(c.CAL_FS_UNITS)          AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    SUM(c.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)   AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(c.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    SUM(c.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    SUM(c.CAL_RX_CNT_NS)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    SUM(c.CAL_RX_CNT_RE)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MAX(c.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(c.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(c.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(c.CVD_AMOUNT)            AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    SUM(c.CAL_CVD_UNITS)         AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM cv_base_navix n
  INNER JOIN COMBINE_DATA c
    ON n.MANDT = c.MANDT
   AND n.RETAILSTOREID = c.RETAILSTOREID
   AND n.BUSINESSDAYDATE = c.BUSINESSDAYDATE
  WHERE c.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP >= @ip_upd_timestamp_from
    AND c.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <= @ip_upd_timestamp_to
  GROUP BY
    n.MANDT,
    n.RETAILSTOREID,
    n.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    c.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    c.TRANSCURRENCY
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 16: cv_base_md_compfl_s4_filtered
-- Logic: Filters comp flag master data to the runtime version parameter.
--        Provides FS_COMP_WK and RX_COMP_WK for comp flag calculation.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: comp_ver = @ip_version
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_md_compfl_s4_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE comp_ver = @ip_version
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 17: cv_base_md_hrrp_node_s4_filtered
-- Logic: Filters HRRP hierarchy nodes to CORE_RET parent nodes with
--        valid-to date '99991231'. Used to inner-join and keep only
--        profit centers belonging to the core retail hierarchy.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORE_RET.*'), hryvalto = '99991231'
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_md_hrrp_node_s4_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORE_RET.*')
    AND hryvalto = '99991231'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 18: cv_base_md_srpact_s4
-- Logic: Projects store attribute master data providing store-level
--        dimensional attributes (division, region, district, city, etc.)
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_md_srpact_s4 AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 19: cv_base_md_cepct_s4
-- Logic: Projects profit center text from CEPCT for English language.
--        Provides PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (ltext) for each prctr.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: spras = 'E' (English) implied by LTEXT usage
-- =====================================================================
cv_base_md_cepct_s4 AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 20: FLASH
-- Logic: Reads flash sales base data, filters out store IDs between
--        '0000020000' and '0000024999', applies BUSINESSDAYDATE filter
--        from parameters, and computes CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE by adding
--        days to reach the Saturday (week-ending day) from BUSINESSDAYDATE.
-- Source: cv_base_fin_flash_sales_car_filtered
-- Filters: RETAILSTOREID < '0000020000' OR RETAILSTOREID > '0000024999',
--          BUSINESSDAYDATE BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- Calculation: CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = Saturday of the week containing
--              BUSINESSDAYDATE (HANA: add_days to reach weekday=5/Saturday)
-- =====================================================================
FLASH AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    RETAILSTOREID AS RETAILSTOREID_CAR,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    FORMAT_DATE(
      '%Y%m%d',
      DATE_ADD(
        PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE),
        INTERVAL (
          5 - CASE
            WHEN MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE)) + 5, 7) = 6
              THEN -1
            ELSE MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE)) + 5, 7)
          END
        ) DAY
      )
    ) AS CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE
  FROM cv_base_fin_flash_sales_car_filtered
  WHERE (RETAILSTOREID < '0000020000' OR RETAILSTOREID > '0000024999')
    AND BUSINESSDAYDATE >= @ip_week_ending_from
    AND BUSINESSDAYDATE <= @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 21: WEEK
-- Logic: Left-joins FLASH to retail calendar on computed week-ending
--        date = zrwenddate. Enriches flash data with week/year/period
--        attributes from the retail calendar.
-- Source: FLASH, cv_base_md_rcalweek_s4
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = zrwenddate
-- =====================================================================
WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    rc.zzweek,
    rc.zryear,
    rc.zrperiod,
    rc.zryrp,
    rc.zrwenddate,
    rc.zrwstrtdate,
    f.MANDT,
    f.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    f.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    f.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    f.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    f.RETAILSTOREID_CAR,
    f.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.TRANSCURRENCY,
    f.CVD_AMOUNT,
    f.CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM FLASH f
  LEFT JOIN cv_base_md_rcalweek_s4 rc
    ON f.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = rc.zrwenddate
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 22: Joined_Week_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left-joins WEEK data to store attribute master on
--        RETAILSTOREID_CAR = strnum. Enriches with store-level
--        dimensional attributes (division, region, district, etc.)
-- Source: WEEK, cv_base_md_srpact_s4
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on RETAILSTOREID_CAR = strnum
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Week_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    sa.prctr,
    sa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    sa.rep_mkt_code,
    sa.rep_mkt_desc,
    sa.division_code,
    sa.division_desc,
    sa.region_code,
    sa.region_desc,
    sa.district_code,
    sa.district_desc,
    sa.city,
    sa.state,
    sa.fs_open_dat,
    sa.rx_open_dat,
    sa.area_code,
    sa.area_desc,
    sa.rx_division_code,
    sa.rx_area_code,
    sa.rx_region_code,
    sa.rx_district_code,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    w.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    w.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    w.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    w.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    w.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    w.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    w.MANDT,
    w.zzweek,
    w.zryear,
    w.zrperiod,
    w.zryrp,
    w.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    w.RETAILSTOREID_CAR AS RETAILSTOREID,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    w.zrwenddate,
    w.zrwstrtdate,
    w.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.TRANSCURRENCY,
    w.CVD_AMOUNT,
    w.CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM WEEK w
  LEFT JOIN cv_base_md_srpact_s4 sa
    ON w.RETAILSTOREID_CAR = sa.strnum
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 23: Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy
-- Logic: Inner-joins store+week data to HRRP hierarchy nodes to keep
--        only profit centers belonging to the CORE_RET hierarchy
--        (PARNODE matches *CORE_RET*, HRYVALTO = '99991231').
-- Source: Joined_Week_Store_Attributes, cv_base_md_hrrp_node_s4_filtered
-- Join: INNER JOIN on prctr = nodevalue
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy AS (
  SELECT
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    j.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    j.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    j.MANDT,
    j.zzweek,
    j.zryear,
    j.zrperiod,
    j.zryrp,
    j.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    j.RETAILSTOREID,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.prctr,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.TRANSCURRENCY,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.CVD_AMOUNT,
    j.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Week_Store_Attributes j
  INNER JOIN cv_base_md_hrrp_node_s4_filtered h
    ON j.prctr = h.nodevalue
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 24: Joined_Comp_Flag_Data
-- Logic: Left-joins hierarchy-filtered data to comp flag master
--        (filtered by @ip_version) on prctr and zzweek = zweek.
--        Brings in FS_COMP_WK and RX_COMP_WK.
-- Source: Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy, cv_base_md_compfl_s4_filtered
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on prctr = prctr AND zzweek = zweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Comp_Flag_Data AS (
  SELECT
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    j.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    j.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    j.MANDT,
    j.zzweek,
    j.zryear,
    j.zrperiod,
    j.zryrp,
    j.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    j.RETAILSTOREID,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.prctr,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.TRANSCURRENCY,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    cf.fs_comp_wk,
    cf.rx_comp_wk,
    j.CVD_AMOUNT,
    j.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy j
  LEFT JOIN cv_base_md_compfl_s4_filtered cf
    ON j.prctr = cf.prctr
   AND j.zzweek = cf.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 25: CALCULATIONS
-- Logic: Computes derived KPI columns from joined flash + comp flag data:
--        CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, CAL_COMP_FLAG, CAL_WEEK_NUMBER.
-- Source: Joined_Comp_Flag_Data
-- Calculation:
--   CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 = CAL_RX_CNT_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_RE +
--                       (CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE) * 2
--   CAL_COMP_FLAG = IF(GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) IS NULL, '0',
--                      GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk))
--   CAL_WEEK_NUMBER = RIGHT(zzweek, 2)
-- =====================================================================
CALCULATIONS AS (
  SELECT
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    rep_mkt_code,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    prctr,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    MANDT,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    -- CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_RE + (CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE) * 2
      AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG: HANA scalar MAX(a,b) -> BigQuery GREATEST
    CASE
      WHEN GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) IS NULL THEN '0'
      ELSE GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk)
    END AS CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    -- CAL_WEEK_NUMBER: last 2 chars of zzweek
    RIGHT(zzweek, 2) AS CAL_WEEK_NUMBER
  FROM Joined_Comp_Flag_Data
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 26: EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT
-- Logic: Aggregates employee discount amounts by dimensional grain,
--        computes synthetic PRCTR values (CAL_PRCTR) based on
--        CAL_COMP_FLAG: '1' -> '0000562075', '0' -> '0000562076'.
--        Preserves PRCTR_ORG for reference.
-- Source: CALCULATIONS
-- Aggregation: SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT), MAX timestamps
-- Calculation: CAL_PRCTR = CASE(CAL_COMP_FLAG, '1', '0000562075',
--                                '0', '0000562076', NULL)
-- =====================================================================
EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    MANDT,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    prctr AS PRCTR_ORG,
    MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    CASE
      WHEN CAL_COMP_FLAG = '1' THEN '0000562075'
      WHEN CAL_COMP_FLAG = '0' THEN '0000562076'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS CAL_PRCTR
  FROM CALCULATIONS
  GROUP BY
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    MANDT,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    prctr,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 27: comp_noncomp_store_attr
-- Logic: Filters store attribute master to synthetic comp/non-comp
--        profit centers ('0000562075', '0000562076'). Used to enrich
--        employee discount rows with dimensional attributes.
-- Source: cv_base_md_srpact_s4
-- Filters: prctr IN ('0000562075', '0000562076')
-- =====================================================================
comp_noncomp_store_attr AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    city,
    state,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE prctr IN ('0000562075', '0000562076')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 28: Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left-joins employee discount aggregates to comp/non-comp store
--        attributes on CAL_PRCTR = prctr. Enriches employee discount
--        rows with store dimensional attributes.
-- Source: EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT, comp_noncomp_store_attr
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on CAL_PRCTR = prctr
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    ed.MANDT,
    ed.CAL_PRCTR AS prctr,
    ed.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    ed.zzweek,
    ed.zryear,
    ed.zrperiod,
    ed.zryrp,
    ed.zrwenddate,
    ed.zrwstrtdate,
    ed.CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    ed.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    sa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    sa.rep_mkt_code,
    sa.rep_mkt_desc,
    sa.division_code,
    sa.division_desc,
    sa.region_code,
    sa.region_desc,
    sa.district_code,
    sa.district_desc,
    sa.city,
    sa.state,
    ed.CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    ed.rx_comp_wk,
    ed.fs_comp_wk,
    sa.strnum,
    ed.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    ed.fs_open_dat,
    ed.rx_open_dat,
    ed.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.TRANSCURRENCY,
    sa.area_code,
    sa.area_desc,
    sa.rx_division_code,
    sa.rx_area_code,
    sa.rx_region_code,
    sa.rx_district_code
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT ed
  LEFT JOIN comp_noncomp_store_attr sa
    ON ed.CAL_PRCTR = sa.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 29: Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount
-- Logic: Unions sales calculation rows (with NULL EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)
--        and employee discount rows (with NULL sales/script/CVD measures).
--        Produces the combined row set for profit center text join and
--        final aggregation.
-- Source: CALCULATIONS (Branch 1), Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes (Branch 2)
-- =====================================================================
Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount AS (
  -- Branch 1: Sales rows from CALCULATIONS
  SELECT
    RETAILSTOREID,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MANDT,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM CALCULATIONS

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 2: Employee discount rows
  SELECT
    strnum AS RETAILSTOREID,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MANDT,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 30: Join_5 (CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH)
-- Logic: Left-joins the combined flash+employee-discount data to profit
--        center text by prctr. This produces the CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH output
--        which is then aggregated per the CUBE/Aggregation model.
-- Source: Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount, cv_base_md_cepct_s4
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on prctr = prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_5 AS (
  SELECT
    u.MANDT,
    u.RETAILSTOREID,
    u.prctr,
    u.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    u.zzweek,
    u.zryear,
    u.zrperiod,
    u.zryrp,
    u.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    u.fs_comp_wk,
    u.rx_comp_wk,
    u.emerg_mkt_ind,
    u.rep_mkt_code,
    u.rep_mkt_desc,
    u.CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    u.division_code,
    u.division_desc,
    u.region_code,
    u.region_desc,
    u.district_code,
    u.district_desc,
    u.zrwenddate,
    u.zrwstrtdate,
    u.CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    u.city,
    u.state,
    u.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    u.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    u.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    u.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    u.CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    u.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    pct.profit_center_text,
    u.fs_open_dat,
    u.rx_open_dat,
    u.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.TRANSCURRENCY,
    u.area_code,
    u.area_desc,
    u.CVD_AMOUNT,
    u.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    u.rx_division_code,
    u.rx_area_code,
    u.rx_region_code,
    u.rx_district_code
  FROM Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount u
  LEFT JOIN cv_base_md_cepct_s4 pct
    ON u.prctr = pct.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 31: cv_comp_fin_flash_aggregated
-- Logic: Aggregates CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH (Join_5) per CUBE/Aggregation
--        model. GROUP BY all non-measure attributes; SUM/MAX measures.
--        This is the CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH output consumed by
--        CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC.
-- Source: Join_5
-- Aggregation: SUM for sales/count/unit/discount/CVD; MAX for timestamps
-- =====================================================================
cv_comp_fin_flash_aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    profit_center_text,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    SUM(FS_SALESAMOUNT)        AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(REDUCTIONAMOUNT)       AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(RX_SALESAMOUNT)        AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_FS_UNITS)          AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3)     AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_NS)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_RE)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)   AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(CVD_AMOUNT)            AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_CVD_UNITS)         AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM Join_5
  GROUP BY
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    profit_center_text,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 32: cv_comp_fin_flash_static_from_tbl
-- Logic: Reads CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC which projects from
--        TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES (a staging table populated by the
--        CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH pipeline above). Aggregates per CUBE model.
--        NOTE: TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES is NOT in Columns_Mapping_v3.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: MISSING TABLE MAPPING for TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES.
--        The CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC logic is supplied and reads from
--        TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES. The lineage shows CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC
--        uses CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC as its flash source.
--        This CTE represents that layer using the supplied converted SQL.
-- Source: PROJECT.DATASET.TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES (UNRESOLVED BQ mapping)
-- Aggregation: SUM for sales/count/unit/discount/CVD; MAX for timestamps
-- =====================================================================
cv_comp_fin_flash_static_from_tbl AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    PRCTR,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    ZZWEEK,
    ZRYEAR,
    ZRPERIOD,
    ZRYRP,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    FS_COMP_WK,
    RX_COMP_WK,
    EMERG_MKT_IND,
    REP_MKT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_DESC,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    DIVISION_CODE,
    DIVISION_DESC,
    REGION_CODE,
    REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE,
    DISTRICT_DESC,
    ZRWENDDATE,
    ZRWSTRTDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    FS_OPEN_DAT,
    RX_OPEN_DAT,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP,
    CREATED_BY,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    AREA_CODE,
    AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    RX_AREA_CODE,
    RX_REGION_CODE,
    RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    SUM(FS_SALESAMOUNT)        AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(REDUCTIONAMOUNT)       AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(RX_SALESAMOUNT)        AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_FS_UNITS)          AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3)     AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_NS)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_RE)         AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)   AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)      AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(CVD_AMOUNT)            AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_CVD_UNITS)         AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM `PROJECT.DATASET.TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES`
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Replace PROJECT.DATASET.TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES
  -- with actual BQ table. Not in Columns_Mapping_v3.
  GROUP BY
    MANDT, RETAILSTOREID, PRCTR, BUSINESSDAYDATE, ZZWEEK, ZRYEAR,
    ZRPERIOD, ZRYRP, CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE, FS_COMP_WK, RX_COMP_WK,
    EMERG_MKT_IND, REP_MKT_CODE, REP_MKT_DESC, CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_DESC, REGION_CODE, REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE, DISTRICT_DESC, ZRWENDDATE, ZRWSTRTDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT, FS_OPEN_DAT,
    RX_OPEN_DAT, ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP, SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP, CREATED_BY,
    TRANSCURRENCY, AREA_CODE, AREA_DESC, RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    RX_AREA_CODE, RX_REGION_CODE, RX_DISTRICT_CODE
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 33: Projected_Flash_With_Budget
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN between CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC (flash source)
--        and CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (budget source) on PRCTR, SEGMENT,
--        WEEK_ENDING. Both sides filtered by @ip_week_ending_from /
--        @ip_week_ending_to. This is Step 1 of CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC
-- Source: cv_comp_fin_flash_static_from_tbl (flash),
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR=PRCTR, SEGMENT=SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING=WEEK_ENDING
-- Filters: flash WEEK_ENDING BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Flash_With_Budget AS (
  SELECT
    f.PRCTR,
    f.ZZWEEK                AS SEGMENT,
    -- NOTE: SEGMENT in CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC corresponds to the
    -- SEGMENT dimension column. In CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC the equivalent
    -- is the store segment. WEEK_ENDING in the combined view = ZZWEEK from flash.
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Confirm SEGMENT and WEEK_ENDING column mapping
    -- between CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC and CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC.
    f.ZZWEEK                AS WEEK_ENDING,
    f.PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    f.CAL_COMP_FLAG         AS COMP_FLAG,
    f.CAL_COMP_FLAG         AS BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    -- NOTE: BUDGET_COMP_FLAG source from CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC is UNRESOLVED.
    -- Using CAL_COMP_FLAG as proxy. REQUIRES VALIDATION.
    f.FS_COMP_WK,
    f.RX_COMP_WK,
    f.ZRYEAR                AS FISCAL_YEAR,
    f.ZRPERIOD              AS FISCAL_PERIOD,
    f.ZZWEEK                AS FISCAL_WEEK,
    f.ZRWSTRTDATE           AS ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP,
    f.ZRWENDDATE            AS ZRWENDDATE_SAP,
    NULL                    AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    NULL                    AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    f.FS_OPEN_DAT           AS FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    f.RX_OPEN_DAT           AS RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    f.EMERG_MKT_IND,
    f.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3     AS CAL_FS_SALES_MJE,
    -- NOTE: CAL_FS_SALES_MJE in combined view = MJE adjustment.
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Confirm exact column mapping.
    f.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.FS_SALESAMOUNT        AS RX_BUDGET,
    -- NOTE: RX_BUDGET from CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC is UNRESOLVED.
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION.
    b.FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    f.DIVISION_CODE,
    f.DIVISION_DESC,
    f.REGION_CODE,
    f.REGION_DESC,
    f.DISTRICT_CODE,
    f.DISTRICT_DESC,
    f.AREA_CODE,
    f.AREA_DESC,
    f.RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    f.RX_AREA_CODE,
    f.RX_REGION_CODE,
    f.RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    f.REP_MKT_CODE,
    f.REP_MKT_DESC,
    f.CITY,
    f.STATE,
    f.TRANSCURRENCY
  FROM cv_comp_fin_flash_static_from_tbl f
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC` b
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC not supplied.
  -- Replace with actual BQ object.
    ON f.PRCTR   = b.PRCTR
   AND f.ZZWEEK  = b.SEGMENT
   AND f.ZZWEEK  = b.WEEK_ENDING
  WHERE f.ZZWEEK >= @ip_week_ending_from
    AND f.ZZWEEK <= @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 34: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN with CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC to add
--        SKF_BUDGET_QTY. Step 2 of CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC
-- Source: Projected_Flash_With_Budget,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF AS (
  SELECT
    fb.*,
    sk.SKF_BUDGET_QTY
  FROM Projected_Flash_With_Budget fb
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC` sk
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_SKF_BUDGET_STATIC not supplied.
    ON fb.PRCTR       = sk.PRCTR
   AND fb.SEGMENT     = sk.SEGMENT
   AND fb.WEEK_ENDING = sk.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 35: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN with CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC to add
--        FIN_FCST_AMOUNT and SKF_FCST_QTY. Step 3.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC
-- Source: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast AS (
  SELECT
    fbs.*,
    fc.FIN_FCST_AMOUNT,
    fc.SKF_FCST_QTY
  FROM Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF fbs
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC` fc
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_FORECAST_MJE_STATIC not supplied.
    ON fbs.PRCTR       = fc.PRCTR
   AND fbs.SEGMENT     = fc.SEGMENT
   AND fbs.WEEK_ENDING = fc.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 36: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN with CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC to add
--        FIN_LY_AMOUNT. Step 4.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC
-- Source: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual AS (
  SELECT
    fbf.*,
    ac.FIN_LY_AMOUNT
  FROM Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast fbf
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC` ac
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC not supplied.
    ON fbf.PRCTR       = ac.PRCTR
   AND fbf.SEGMENT     = ac.SEGMENT
   AND fbf.WEEK_ENDING = ac.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 37: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual_SKFActual
-- Logic: LEFT OUTER JOIN with CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC to add
--        SKF_LY_QTY, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR, SKF_MJE_QTY, CAL_RX_SALES_MJE.
--        Step 5.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC
-- Source: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual_SKFActual AS (
  SELECT
    fbfa.*,
    sa.SKF_LY_QTY,
    sa.CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR,
    sa.SKF_MJE_QTY,
    sa.CAL_RX_SALES_MJE
  FROM Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual fbfa
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC` sa
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_SKF_ACTUAL_STATIC not supplied.
    ON fbfa.PRCTR       = sa.PRCTR
   AND fbfa.SEGMENT     = sa.SEGMENT
   AND fbfa.WEEK_ENDING = sa.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 38: Projected_With_Calculated_Columns
-- Logic: Computes primary calculated columns:
--        CAL_FS_SALES, CAL_RX_SALES, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, variance columns,
--        comp columns (non-dependent on CAL_RX_SALES/CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3).
-- Source: Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual_SKFActual
-- Calculation: See CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC formulas
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_Calculated_Columns AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR,
    SEGMENT,
    WEEK_ENDING,
    PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    COMP_FLAG,
    BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    FS_COMP_WK,
    RX_COMP_WK,
    FISCAL_YEAR,
    FISCAL_PERIOD,
    FISCAL_WEEK,
    ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP,
    ZRWENDDATE_SAP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    EMERG_MKT_IND,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_SALES_MJE,
    FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    FIN_FCST_AMOUNT,
    FIN_LY_AMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_SALES_MJE,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR,
    SKF_MJE_QTY,
    SKF_FCST_QTY,
    SKF_BUDGET_QTY,
    SKF_LY_QTY,
    RX_BUDGET,
    DIVISION_CODE,
    DIVISION_DESC,
    REGION_CODE,
    REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE,
    DISTRICT_DESC,
    AREA_CODE,
    AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    RX_AREA_CODE,
    RX_REGION_CODE,
    RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_DESC,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    -- CAL_FS_SALES
    (FS_SALESAMOUNT - REDUCTIONAMOUNT - EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT + CAL_FS_SALES_MJE)
      AS CAL_FS_SALES,
    -- CAL_RX_SALES
    (RX_SALESAMOUNT + CAL_RX_SALES_MJE)
      AS CAL_RX_SALES,
    -- CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3
    (CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR + SKF_MJE_QTY)
      AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    -- Variance columns
    (FS_SALESAMOUNT - FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT)
      AS CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG = '1', SKF_BUDGET_QTY, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', SKF_FCST_QTY, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', FIN_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', SKF_LY_QTY, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3
  FROM Projected_Flash_Budget_SKF_Forecast_Actual_SKFActual
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 39: Projected_With_Extended_Calc
-- Logic: Extends with CAL_RX_SALES/CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3-dependent columns,
--        ASP interim calculations, and remaining comp columns.
-- Source: Projected_With_Calculated_Columns
-- Calculation: Variance columns, comp columns, ASP interim
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_Extended_Calc AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    COMP_FLAG, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG, FS_COMP_WK, RX_COMP_WK,
    FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_PERIOD, FISCAL_WEEK,
    ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP, ZRWENDDATE_SAP, FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP, FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP, RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    EMERG_MKT_IND, FS_SALESAMOUNT, REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT, CAL_FS_SALES_MJE, FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, FIN_LY_AMOUNT, RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_SALES_MJE, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR, SKF_MJE_QTY,
    SKF_FCST_QTY, SKF_BUDGET_QTY, SKF_LY_QTY, RX_BUDGET,
    DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_DESC, REGION_CODE, REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE, DISTRICT_DESC, AREA_CODE, AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE, RX_AREA_CODE, RX_REGION_CODE, RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE, REP_MKT_DESC, CITY, STATE, TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAL_FS_SALES, CAL_RX_SALES, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR, CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3, CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3, CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT, CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1', FS_SALESAMOUNT - FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_FS_FCST_VAR,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1', FS_SALESAMOUNT - FIN_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_FS_LY_VAR,
    (CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 - SKF_FCST_QTY)    AS CAL_SCRIPTS_FCST_VAR,
    (CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 - SKF_BUDGET_QTY)  AS CAL_SCRIPTS_BUDGET_VAR,
    (CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 - SKF_LY_QTY)      AS CAL_SCRIPTS_LY_VAR,
    (CAL_FS_SALES - FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT)     AS CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1', CAL_FS_SALES - FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1', CAL_FS_SALES - FIN_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR,
    IF(RX_COMP_WK = '1', CAL_RX_SALES - FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_RX_FCST_VAR,
    IF(RX_COMP_WK = '1', CAL_RX_SALES - FIN_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_RX_LY_VAR,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', CAL_FS_SALES, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', FS_SALESAMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT_RAW,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', CAL_RX_SALES, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    IF(COMP_FLAG = '1', CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3,
    IF(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 = 0, 0,
       ROUND(CAL_RX_SALES / CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, 2))
      AS CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP,
    IF(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 = 0, 0,
       ROUND(CAL_RX_SALES / CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, 2))
      AS CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP
  FROM Projected_With_Calculated_Columns
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 40: FILTER_Segment_CONVDRUG
-- Logic: Applies SEGMENT filter: keep rows where SEGMENT IS NULL or
--        UPPER(SEGMENT) = 'CONVDRUG'.
-- Source: Projected_With_Extended_Calc
-- Filters: SEGMENT IS NULL OR UPPER(SEGMENT) = 'CONVDRUG'
-- =====================================================================
FILTER_Segment_CONVDRUG AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Projected_With_Extended_Calc
  WHERE SEGMENT IS NULL
     OR UPPER(SEGMENT) = 'CONVDRUG'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 41: Projected_With_ASP_Change
-- Logic: Computes CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT using interim CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP
--        (two-pass approximation for circular dependency resolution).
-- Source: FILTER_Segment_CONVDRUG
-- Calculation: CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP_INTERIM, CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_ASP_Change AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    IF(SKF_BUDGET_QTY = 0, 0,
       ROUND(CAL_RX_SALES / SKF_BUDGET_QTY, 2))
      AS CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP_INTERIM,
    IF(
      IF(SKF_BUDGET_QTY = 0, 0,
         ROUND(CAL_RX_SALES / SKF_BUDGET_QTY, 2)) = 0,
      0,
      ROUND(
        (CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP /
         IF(SKF_BUDGET_QTY = 0, 0,
            ROUND(CAL_RX_SALES / SKF_BUDGET_QTY, 2))
        ) - 1, 4
      )
    ) AS CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT
  FROM FILTER_Segment_CONVDRUG
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 42: Projected_With_ASP_Adj
-- Logic: Computes CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT from CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT.
-- Source: Projected_With_ASP_Change
-- Calculation: CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_ASP_Adj AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    IF(CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT = -1, 0,
       ROUND(CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP / (1 + CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT), 2))
      AS CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT
  FROM Projected_With_ASP_Change
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 43: Projected_With_RX_Budget
-- Logic: Computes CAL_RX_BUDGET.
--        IF(RX_BUDGET=0 OR RX_BUDGET IS NULL,
--           ROUND(SKF_BUDGET_QTY * CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT, 2),
--           RX_BUDGET)
-- Source: Projected_With_ASP_Adj
-- Calculation: CAL_RX_BUDGET
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_RX_Budget AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    IF(RX_BUDGET = 0 OR RX_BUDGET IS NULL,
       ROUND(SKF_BUDGET_QTY * CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT, 2),
       RX_BUDGET)
      AS CAL_RX_BUDGET
  FROM Projected_With_ASP_Adj
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 44: Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP
-- Logic: Recomputes CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP using final CAL_RX_BUDGET,
--        computes CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR. Drops interim columns.
-- Source: Projected_With_RX_Budget
-- Calculation: CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP (final), CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    COMP_FLAG, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG, FS_COMP_WK, RX_COMP_WK,
    FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_PERIOD, FISCAL_WEEK,
    ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP, ZRWENDDATE_SAP, FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP, FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP, RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    EMERG_MKT_IND, FS_SALESAMOUNT, REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT, CAL_FS_SALES_MJE, FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    FIN_FCST_AMOUNT, FIN_LY_AMOUNT, RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_SALES_MJE, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR, SKF_MJE_QTY,
    SKF_FCST_QTY, SKF_BUDGET_QTY, SKF_LY_QTY, RX_BUDGET,
    DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_DESC, REGION_CODE, REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE, DISTRICT_DESC, AREA_CODE, AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE, RX_AREA_CODE, RX_REGION_CODE, RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE, REP_MKT_DESC, CITY, STATE, TRANSCURRENCY,
    CAL_FS_SALES, CAL_RX_SALES, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR, CAL_FS_FCST_VAR, CAL_FS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_FCST_VAR, CAL_SCRIPTS_BUDGET_VAR, CAL_SCRIPTS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR, CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR, CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_RX_FCST_VAR, CAL_RX_LY_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT, CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT_RAW, CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3, CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT, CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT, CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3,
    CAL_RX_BUDGET,
    (CAL_RX_SALES - CAL_RX_BUDGET) AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR,
    IF(SKF_BUDGET_QTY = 0, 0,
       ROUND(CAL_RX_BUDGET / SKF_BUDGET_QTY, 2))
      AS CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP,
    CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP,
    CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT,
    CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP,
    CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT
  FROM Projected_With_RX_Budget
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 45: Aggregated_Budget_Comp_Level
-- Logic: Aggregates CAL_RX_BUDGET at budget comp level
--        (PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG) to compute
--        CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL for the budget comp PRCTR override.
-- Source: Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP
-- Aggregation: SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET) grouped by PRCTR, SEGMENT,
--              WEEK_ENDING, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG
-- =====================================================================
Aggregated_Budget_Comp_Level AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR,
    SEGMENT,
    WEEK_ENDING,
    BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET) AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL
  FROM Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP
  GROUP BY PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 46: Projected_Budget_Comp_PRCTR
-- Logic: Applies PRCTR override for budget comp rows:
--        Filter: BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IS NOT NULL AND (RX_BUDGET=0 OR NULL)
--        Override: PRCTR = IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG='1','0000502656','0000502657')
-- Source: Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP
-- Filters: BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IS NOT NULL, RX_BUDGET = 0 OR IS NULL
-- Calculation: Overridden PRCTR, SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET) as CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL
-- =====================================================================
Projected_Budget_Comp_PRCTR AS (
  SELECT
    IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG = '1', '0000502656', '0000502657') AS PRCTR,
    SEGMENT,
    WEEK_ENDING,
    BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET) AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL
  FROM Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP
  WHERE BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IS NOT NULL
    AND (RX_BUDGET = 0 OR RX_BUDGET IS NULL)
  GROUP BY
    IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG = '1', '0000502656', '0000502657'),
    SEGMENT,
    WEEK_ENDING,
    BUDGET_COMP_FLAG
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 47: Joined_Budget_Comp_Level
-- Logic: Left-joins main data to budget comp level aggregation on
--        PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG to bring in
--        CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL.
-- Source: Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP, Projected_Budget_Comp_PRCTR
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Budget_Comp_Level AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    bc.CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL
  FROM Projected_With_Final_Budget_ASP f
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Projected_Budget_Comp_PRCTR bc
    ON f.PRCTR            = bc.PRCTR
   AND f.SEGMENT          = bc.SEGMENT
   AND f.WEEK_ENDING      = bc.WEEK_ENDING
   AND f.BUDGET_COMP_FLAG = bc.BUDGET_COMP_FLAG
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 48: Projected_With_Comp_RX_Budget
-- Logic: Computes CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL and CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT.
--        CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL = IF(PRCTR IN ('0000502656','0000502657')
--          AND BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IN ('0','1'),
--          RX_BUDGET - CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL, CAL_RX_BUDGET)
--        CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT = IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG='1',
--          CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL, 0)
-- Source: Joined_Budget_Comp_Level
-- Calculation: CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL, CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT
-- =====================================================================
Projected_With_Comp_RX_Budget AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    IF(PRCTR IN ('0000502656', '0000502657')
       AND BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IN ('0', '1'),
       RX_BUDGET - CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL,
       CAL_RX_BUDGET)
      AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL,
    IF(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG = '1',
       IF(PRCTR IN ('0000502656', '0000502657')
          AND BUDGET_COMP_FLAG IN ('0', '1'),
          RX_BUDGET - CAL_RX_BUDGET_COMP_LEVEL,
          CAL_RX_BUDGET),
       0)
      AS CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT
  FROM Joined_Budget_Comp_Level
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 49: Joined_Topside_Adjustments
-- Logic: Left-joins to CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (first instance)
--        to add TOPSIDE_PRCTR and TOPSIDE_SEGMENT.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS is NOT SUPPLIED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: PROCEDURE NOT SUPPLIED - CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS
-- Source: Projected_With_Comp_RX_Budget,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Topside_Adjustments AS (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    t1.TOPSIDE_PRCTR,
    t1.TOPSIDE_SEGMENT
  FROM Projected_With_Comp_RX_Budget m
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS` t1
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS not supplied.
    ON m.PRCTR       = t1.PRCTR
   AND m.SEGMENT     = t1.SEGMENT
   AND m.WEEK_ENDING = t1.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 50: Joined_Topside_Adjustments_1
-- Logic: Left-joins to CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (second instance,
--        alias CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS_1). Additional output columns
--        UNRESOLVED from XML.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION: Second join output columns not determinable.
-- Source: Joined_Topside_Adjustments,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Topside_Adjustments_1 AS (
  SELECT
    jt.*
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Additional columns from second
    -- CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS instance not determinable from XML.
  FROM Joined_Topside_Adjustments jt
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS` t2
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Second CV_COMP_TOPSIDE_ADJUSTMENTS instance.
    ON jt.PRCTR       = t2.PRCTR
   AND jt.SEGMENT     = t2.SEGMENT
   AND jt.WEEK_ENDING = t2.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 51: Joined_Budget_Static_2
-- Logic: Left-joins to second instance of CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC
--        to add CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT.
--        NOTE: CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (second instance) NOT SUPPLIED.
--        Source column name for CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT UNRESOLVED.
--        REQUIRES VALIDATION.
-- Source: Joined_Topside_Adjustments_1,
--         PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC (UNRESOLVED)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN on PRCTR, SEGMENT, WEEK_ENDING
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Budget_Static_2 AS (
  SELECT
    jt1.*,
    b2.CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Verify actual source column name in
    -- second CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC instance.
  FROM Joined_Topside_Adjustments_1 jt1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `PROJECT.DATASET.CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC` b2
  -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: Second CV_COMP_FIN_BUDGET_STATIC instance.
    ON jt1.PRCTR       = b2.PRCTR
   AND jt1.SEGMENT     = b2.SEGMENT
   AND jt1.WEEK_ENDING = b2.WEEK_ENDING
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 52: Final_Aggregated
-- Logic: Final aggregation of CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC.
--        GROUP BY all non-measure attributes; SUM all base measures.
--        dataCategory=CUBE, outputViewType=Aggregation.
-- Source: Joined_Budget_Static_2
-- Aggregation: SUM for all numeric measures
-- =====================================================================
Final_Aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR, SEGMENT, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT, COMP_FLAG, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    FS_COMP_WK, RX_COMP_WK, FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_PERIOD, FISCAL_WEEK,
    WEEK_ENDING, ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP, ZRWENDDATE_SAP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP, RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP, RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP, EMERG_MKT_IND,
    TOPSIDE_PRCTR, TOPSIDE_SEGMENT,
    DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_DESC, REGION_CODE, REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE, DISTRICT_DESC, AREA_CODE, AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE, RX_AREA_CODE, RX_REGION_CODE, RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE, REP_MKT_DESC, CITY, STATE, TRANSCURRENCY,
    SUM(FS_SALESAMOUNT)               AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(REDUCTIONAMOUNT)              AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)          AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_FS_SALES_MJE)             AS CAL_FS_SALES_MJE,
    SUM(FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT)            AS FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(FIN_FCST_AMOUNT)              AS FIN_FCST_AMOUNT,
    SUM(FIN_LY_AMOUNT)                AS FIN_LY_AMOUNT,
    SUM(RX_SALESAMOUNT)               AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_RX_SALES_MJE)             AS CAL_RX_SALES_MJE,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR)        AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR,
    SUM(SKF_MJE_QTY)                  AS SKF_MJE_QTY,
    SUM(SKF_FCST_QTY)                 AS SKF_FCST_QTY,
    SUM(SKF_BUDGET_QTY)               AS SKF_BUDGET_QTY,
    SUM(SKF_LY_QTY)                   AS SKF_LY_QTY,
    SUM(RX_BUDGET)                    AS RX_BUDGET,
    SUM(CAL_FS_SALES)                 AS CAL_FS_SALES,
    SUM(CAL_RX_SALES)                 AS CAL_RX_SALES,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3)            AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET)                AS CAL_RX_BUDGET,
    SUM(CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR)            AS CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_FS_FCST_VAR)              AS CAL_FS_FCST_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_FS_LY_VAR)                AS CAL_FS_LY_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR)            AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_FCST_VAR)         AS CAL_SCRIPTS_FCST_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_BUDGET_VAR)       AS CAL_SCRIPTS_BUDGET_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_LY_VAR)           AS CAL_SCRIPTS_LY_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR)        AS CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR)          AS CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR)            AS CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_RX_FCST_VAR)              AS CAL_RX_FCST_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_RX_LY_VAR)                AS CAL_RX_LY_VAR,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT)    AS CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT)      AS CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT_RAW)  AS CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT_RAW,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT)      AS CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3)        AS CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3)         AS CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT)     AS CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3)      AS CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT)           AS CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3)            AS CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3,
    SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL)          AS CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT)    AS CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP)         AS CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP,
    SUM(CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP)          AS CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP,
    SUM(CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT)         AS CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT,
    SUM(CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP)          AS CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP,
    SUM(CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT)           AS CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT,
    SUM(CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT) AS CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT
  FROM Joined_Budget_Static_2
  GROUP BY
    PRCTR, SEGMENT, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT, COMP_FLAG, BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    FS_COMP_WK, RX_COMP_WK, FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_PERIOD, FISCAL_WEEK,
    WEEK_ENDING, ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP, ZRWENDDATE_SAP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP, RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP, RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP, EMERG_MKT_IND,
    TOPSIDE_PRCTR, TOPSIDE_SEGMENT,
    DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_DESC, REGION_CODE, REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE, DISTRICT_DESC, AREA_CODE, AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE, RX_AREA_CODE, RX_REGION_CODE, RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE, REP_MKT_DESC, CITY, STATE, TRANSCURRENCY
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 53: cv_comp_fin_flash_combined_static_output
-- Logic: Applies post-aggregation calculated attributes and measures
--        for CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC. Produces the full output
--        consumed by CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC.
--        Calculated attributes: CAL_COMP_FLAG, CAL_COMP_FLAG_TEXT,
--        EMERG_MKT_IND_TEXT, ZRWSTRTDATE, ZRWENDDATE,
--        FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP, RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP, FS_OPEN_DATE, RX_OPEN_DATE.
--        Calculated measures: CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_BUDGET, etc.
-- Source: Final_Aggregated
-- Calculation: Post-aggregation calculated attributes and measures
