-- =====================================================================
cv_comp_fin_flash_combined_static_output AS (
  SELECT
    PRCTR,
    SEGMENT,
    PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    COMP_FLAG,
    BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,
    FS_COMP_WK,
    RX_COMP_WK,
    FISCAL_YEAR,
    FISCAL_PERIOD,
    FISCAL_WEEK,
    WEEK_ENDING,
    ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP,
    ZRWENDDATE_SAP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP,
    FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP,
    EMERG_MKT_IND,
    TOPSIDE_PRCTR,
    TOPSIDE_SEGMENT,
    DIVISION_CODE,
    DIVISION_DESC,
    REGION_CODE,
    REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE,
    DISTRICT_DESC,
    AREA_CODE,
    AREA_DESC,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    RX_AREA_CODE,
    RX_REGION_CODE,
    RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_DESC,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG: GREATEST(COALESCE(COMP_FLAG,'0'), COALESCE(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG,'0'))
    GREATEST(COALESCE(COMP_FLAG, '0'), COALESCE(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG, '0'))
      AS CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG_TEXT
    CASE GREATEST(COALESCE(COMP_FLAG, '0'), COALESCE(BUDGET_COMP_FLAG, '0'))
      WHEN '1' THEN 'Comp'
      WHEN '0' THEN 'Non-Comp'
      ELSE ''
    END AS CAL_COMP_FLAG_TEXT,
    -- EMERG_MKT_IND_TEXT
    IF(EMERG_MKT_IND = 'Y', 'Yes', IF(EMERG_MKT_IND = 'N', 'No', ''))
      AS EMERG_MKT_IND_TEXT,
    -- ZRWSTRTDATE: format(date(ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP),'MM/DD/YYYY')
    FORMAT_DATE('%m/%d/%Y', CAST(ZRWSTRTDATE_SAP AS DATE))
      AS ZRWSTRTDATE,
    -- ZRWENDDATE: format(date(ZRWENDDATE_SAP),'MM/DD/YYYY')
    FORMAT_DATE('%m/%d/%Y', CAST(ZRWENDDATE_SAP AS DATE))
      AS ZRWENDDATE,
    -- FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP: timestamp string from FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP
    IF(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP IS NULL, '',
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 5, 2)  || '/' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 7, 2)  || '/' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 1, 4)  || ' ' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 9, 2)  || ':' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 11, 2) || ':' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 13, 2)
    ) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    -- RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP
    IF(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP IS NULL, '',
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 5, 2)  || '/' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 7, 2)  || '/' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 1, 4)  || ' ' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 9, 2)  || ':' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 11, 2) || ':' ||
       SUBSTR(CAST(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP_SAP AS STRING), 13, 2)
    ) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    -- FS_OPEN_DATE
    FORMAT_DATE('%m/%d/%Y', CAST(FS_OPEN_DAT_SAP AS DATE))
      AS FS_OPEN_DATE,
    -- RX_OPEN_DATE
    FORMAT_DATE('%m/%d/%Y', CAST(RX_OPEN_DAT_SAP AS DATE))
      AS RX_OPEN_DATE,
    -- Base measures (already aggregated)
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_SALES_MJE,
    FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    FIN_FCST_AMOUNT,
    FIN_LY_AMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_SALES_MJE,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3_CAR,
    SKF_MJE_QTY,
    SKF_FCST_QTY,
    SKF_BUDGET_QTY,
    SKF_LY_QTY,
    RX_BUDGET,
    CAL_FS_SALES,
    CAL_RX_SALES,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAL_RX_BUDGET,
    CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR,
    CAL_FS_FCST_VAR,
    CAL_FS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_RX_BUDGET_VAR,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_FCST_VAR,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_BUDGET_VAR,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_RX_FCST_VAR,
    CAL_RX_LY_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT_RAW,
    CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3,
    CAL_RX_BUDGET_FINAL,
    CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    CAL_TOTAL_BUDGET_ASP,
    CAL_TOTAL_FLASH_ASP,
    CAL_ASP_CHANGE_PERCT,
    CAL_STORE_FLASH_ASP,
    CAL_ASP_ADJ_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT,
    -- Calculated measures (post-aggregation)
    (CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_BUDGET,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_FORECAST,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_LY,
    (CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT)
      AS CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_BUDGET,
    IF(RX_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_FORECAST,
    IF(RX_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT - CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_LY,
    (CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3 - CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3)
      AS CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_FORECAST,
    (CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3 - CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3)
      AS CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_BUDGET,
    (CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3 - CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3)
      AS CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_LY,
    (CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT - CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT)
      AS CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_BUDGET,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT - CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_FORECAST,
    IF(FS_COMP_WK = '1',
       CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT - CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT, 0)
      AS CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_LY,
    -- Additional columns needed by CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC
    -- that map from CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC output:
    -- FS_RX_FLAG, FS_RX_FLAG_EXT, SBT, CAL_WEEK_NUMBER, STRNUM,
    -- FIN_BUD_CUBE, SKF_BUD_CUBE, DESCRIPTION, SALES_SOURCE,
    -- SC_90AS1_BUD, SC_90AS1_FCT, SC_90AS1_FLASH, SC_90AS1_LY,
    -- CAL_CVD_UNITS, CVD_AMOUNT
    -- NOTE: These columns are referenced in CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC
    -- but their source definitions in CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC
    -- are UNRESOLVED (not in the supplied combined_static converted file).
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION for: FS_RX_FLAG, FS_RX_FLAG_EXT, SBT,
    -- CAL_WEEK_NUMBER, STRNUM, FIN_BUD_CUBE, SKF_BUD_CUBE,
    -- DESCRIPTION, SALES_SOURCE, SC_90AS1_*, CAL_CVD_UNITS, CVD_AMOUNT
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_RX_FLAG,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FS_RX_FLAG_EXT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS SBT,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS STRNUM,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS FIN_BUD_CUBE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SKF_BUD_CUBE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS DESCRIPTION,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS SALES_SOURCE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS SC_90AS1_BUD,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS SC_90AS1_FCT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS SC_90AS1_FLASH,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS SC_90AS1_LY,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT
  FROM Final_Aggregated
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 54: WEEKLY_FLASH
-- Logic: Projects from CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_COMBINED_STATIC output,
--        applying the column renames defined in
--        CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC's projection node:
--        CAL_EMERG_MKT_IND -> EMERG_MKT_IND (rename preserved).
--        All other columns pass through with direct mapping.
--        This is the WEEKLY_FLASH projection node of the final consumer.
-- Source: cv_comp_fin_flash_combined_static_output
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_FLASH AS (
  SELECT
    DIVISION_CODE,
    DIVISION_DESC,
    REGION_CODE,
    REGION_DESC,
    DISTRICT_CODE,
    DISTRICT_DESC,
    STRNUM,
    PRCTR,
    REP_MKT_CODE,
    REP_MKT_DESC,
    FS_RX_FLAG,
    WEEK_ENDING                AS bic_zio_sweek,
    -- NOTE: _BIC_ZIO_SWEEK in CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC maps to
    -- bic_zio_sweek per Columns_Mapping_v3 (AZSRP_DS041_VT_S4._BIC_ZIO_SWEEK).
    -- The source column WEEK_ENDING is used as proxy. REQUIRES VALIDATION.
    CAL_FS_SALES,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    SKF_BUDGET_QTY,
    FIN_FCST_AMOUNT,
    SKF_FCST_QTY,
    FIN_LY_AMOUNT,
    SKF_LY_QTY,
    CAL_RX_BUDGET,
    FS_RX_FLAG_EXT,
    EMERG_MKT_IND,
    -- NOTE: CAL_EMERG_MKT_IND -> EMERG_MKT_IND rename preserved from
    -- CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC projection.
    ZRWSTRTDATE,
    ZRWENDDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS FS_BUDGET_CURRENCY,
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: FS_BUDGET_CURRENCY source not in supplied files.
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS FIN_LY_CURRENCY,
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: FIN_LY_CURRENCY source not in supplied files.
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS FIN_FORECAST_CURRENCY,
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: FIN_FORECAST_CURRENCY source not in supplied files.
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS RX_BUDGET_CURRENCY,
    -- REQUIRES VALIDATION: RX_BUDGET_CURRENCY source not in supplied files.
    CAL_RX_BUD_VAR             AS CAL_RX_BUD_VAR,
    CAL_FS_BUDGET_VAR          AS CAL_FS_BUD_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_BUDGET_VAR      AS CAL_FS_BUD_CORP_VAR,
    CAL_RX_FCST_VAR            AS CAL_RX_FORECAST_VAR,
    CAL_RX_LY_VAR,
    CAL_FS_FCST_VAR            AS CAL_FS_FORECAST_VAR,
    CAL_FS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_FCST_VAR        AS CAL_FS_FORECAST_CORP_VAR,
    CAL_CORPFS_LY_VAR          AS CAL_FS_LY_CORP_VAR,
    PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS CAL_DATA_CATEGORY1,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS CAL_DATA_CATEGORY2,
    FS_OPEN_DATE               AS FS_OPEN_DAT,
    RX_OPEN_DATE               AS RX_OPEN_DAT,
    CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT AS CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT,
    CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3,
    CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_BUDGET     AS CAL_COMP_FS_BUD_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_FORECAST   AS CAL_COMP_FS_FORECAST_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_FS_VAR_LY         AS CAL_COMP_FS_LY_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_BUDGET     AS CAL_COMP_RX_BUD_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_FORECAST   AS CAL_COMP_RX_FORECAST_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_RX_VAR_LY         AS CAL_COMP_RX_LY_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_FORECAST AS CAL_COMP_SKF_FORECAST_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_BUDGET   AS CAL_COMP_SKF_BUD_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_SCRIPTS_VAR_LY       AS CAL_COMP_SKF_LY_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_BUDGET    AS CAL_COMP_FS_BUD_CORP_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_FORECAST  AS CAL_COMP_FS_FORECAST_CORP_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_CORPFS_VAR_LY        AS CAL_COMP_FS_LY_CORP_VAR,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)      AS SKF_MJE_QTY_OUT,
    -- NOTE: SKF_MJE_QTY in output - not exposed in logical model
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)      AS CAL_FS_SALES_MJE_OUT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)      AS CAL_RX_SALES_MJE_OUT,
    CAL_RX_SALES,
    SBT,
    SEGMENT,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING)       AS DESCRIPTION_OUT,
    SC_90AS1_BUD,
    SC_90AS1_FCT,
    SC_90AS1_FLASH,
    SC_90AS1_LY,
    SALES_SOURCE,
    AREA_CODE,
    AREA_DESC,
    FIN_BUD_CUBE,
    SKF_BUD_CUBE,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    RX_AREA_CODE,
    RX_REGION_CODE,
    RX_DISTRICT_CODE
  FROM cv_comp_fin_flash_combined_static_output
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT: CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC
-- Logic: Final aggregation of the WEEKLY_FLASH projection per
--        CV_CONS_WEEKLY_FLASH_REPORT_STATIC logical model.
--        dataCategory=CUBE, outputViewType=Aggregation.
--        GROUP BY all non-measure output attributes.
--        SUM all measure output columns.
--        CAL_COMP_FLAG aliased as COMP_FLAG per logical model rename.
-- Source: WEEKLY_FLASH
-- Aggregation: SUM for all measures; GROUP BY for all attributes
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  -- Non-measure output attributes (GROUP BY)
  DIVISION_CODE,
  DIVISION_DESC,
  REGION_CODE,
  DISTRICT_CODE,
  REGION_DESC,
  DISTRICT_DESC,
  STRNUM,
  PRCTR,
  REP_MKT_CODE,
  REP_MKT_DESC,
  FS_RX_FLAG,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  FS_RX_FLAG_EXT,
  EMERG_MKT_IND,
  ZRWSTRTDATE,
  ZRWENDDATE,
  CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  FS_BUDGET_CURRENCY,
  FIN_LY_CURRENCY,
  FIN_FORECAST_CURRENCY,
  RX_BUDGET_CURRENCY,
  PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
  FS_OPEN_DAT,
  RX_OPEN_DAT,
  CAL_COMP_FLAG AS comp_flag,
  SEGMENT,
  SALES_SOURCE,
  AREA_CODE,
  AREA_DESC,
  FIN_BUD_CUBE,
  SKF_BUD_CUBE,
  RX_DIVISION_CODE,
  RX_AREA_CODE,
  RX_REGION_CODE,
  RX_DISTRICT_CODE,
  -- Measure outputs (SUM aggregation)
  SUM(CAL_FS_SALES)                 AS cal_fs_sales,
  SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3)            AS cal_scripts_90as3,
  SUM(FIN_BUDGET_AMOUNT)            AS fin_budget_amount,
  SUM(SKF_BUDGET_QTY)               AS skf_budget_qty,
  SUM(FIN_FCST_AMOUNT)              AS fin_fcst_amount,
  SUM(SKF_FCST_QTY)                 AS skf_fcst_qty,
  SUM(FIN_LY_AMOUNT)                AS fin_ly_amount,
  SUM(SKF_LY_QTY)                   AS skf_ly_qty,
  SUM(CAL_RX_BUDGET)                AS cal_rx_budget,
  SUM(CAL_RX_BUD_VAR)               AS cal_rx_bud_var,
  SUM(CAL_FS_BUD_CORP_VAR)          AS cal_fs_bud_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_RX_FORECAST_VAR)          AS cal_rx_forecast_var,
  SUM(CAL_RX_LY_VAR)                AS cal_rx_ly_var,
  SUM(CAL_FS_FORECAST_CORP_VAR)     AS cal_fs_forecast_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_FS_LY_CORP_VAR)           AS cal_fs_ly_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_BUDGET_AMOUNT)    AS cal_comp_fs_budget_amount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_BUDGET_AMOUNT)    AS cal_comp_rx_budget_amount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_CORPFS_SALES_AMOUNT) AS cal_comp_corpfs_sales_amount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_SALESAMOUNT)      AS cal_comp_rx_salesamount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_BUDGET_90AS3)        AS cal_comp_budget_90as3,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FLASH_90AS3)         AS cal_comp_flash_90as3,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FORECAST_AMOUNT)     AS cal_comp_forecast_amount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FORECAST_90AS3)      AS cal_comp_forecast_90as3,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_LY_AMOUNT)           AS cal_comp_ly_amount,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_LY_90AS3)            AS cal_comp_ly_90as3,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_BUD_VAR)          AS cal_comp_rx_bud_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_FORECAST_VAR)     AS cal_comp_rx_forecast_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_RX_LY_VAR)           AS cal_comp_rx_ly_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_SKF_FORECAST_VAR)    AS cal_comp_skf_forecast_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_SKF_BUD_VAR)         AS cal_comp_skf_bud_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_SKF_LY_VAR)          AS cal_comp_skf_ly_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_BUD_CORP_VAR)     AS cal_comp_fs_bud_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_FORECAST_CORP_VAR) AS cal_comp_fs_forecast_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_COMP_FS_LY_CORP_VAR)      AS cal_comp_fs_ly_corp_var,
  SUM(CAL_RX_SALES)                 AS cal_rx_sales,
  SUM(SC_90AS1_BUD)                 AS sc_90as1_bud,
  SUM(SC_90AS1_FCT)                 AS sc_90as1_fct,
  SUM(SC_90AS1_FLASH)               AS sc_90as1_flash,
  SUM(SC_90AS1_LY)                  AS sc_90as1_ly,
  SUM(CAL_CVD_UNITS)                AS cal_cvd_units,
  SUM(CVD_AMOUNT)                   AS cvd_amount
FROM WEEKLY_FLASH
GROUP BY
  DIVISION_CODE,
  DIVISION_DESC,
  REGION_CODE,
  DISTRICT_CODE,
  REGION_DESC,
  DISTRICT_DESC,
  STRNUM,
  PRCTR,
